# Background

Original fixture prose for Latchkit's test suite. The sample application
has no sign-in flow yet, so every visitor sees the same shared view.

# Proposal

Add a sign-in form backed by the existing user table, and gate the
dashboard behind it. See [additional notes](../docs/add-login-notes.md)
for background research.

# Implementation Plan

- [ ] A: Sign-in form
  - [ ] A.1: Add the sign-in form component in src/components/sign-in-form.tsx
  - [x] A.2: Wire the form to the auth service
- [ ] B: Route gating
  - [ ] B.1: Redirect anonymous visitors away from the dashboard

# Test Plan

- [ ] T.1: Valid sign-in
  - **Given** a registered account
  - **When** the user submits valid credentials
  - **Then** the dashboard is shown
